Which statement about elements and their atoms is correct?
A
Aluminium is in the second period of the Periodic Table and has two occupied electron
shells.
B
Helium is in Group VIII of the Periodic Table and has eight outer shell electrons.
C
Lithium is in Group I of the Periodic Table and has one occupied electron shell.
D
Sulfur is in the third period of the Periodic Table and has six outer shell electrons.
